title: Utility Types: Function and Constructor Types knowledge check

questions.prompt: What makes a function type useful?
options: It documents parameter and return contracts so callers and implementations can be checked consistently.
It automatically tests the function at runtime.
It causes the function to run when the type is declared.
It replaces all runtime error handling.
questions.answer_key: It documents parameter and return contracts so callers and implementations can be checked consistently.
questions.explanation: Function types are compile-time contracts and should be paired with behavior tests.

questions.answer_key: The concept should be demonstrated with parameters and checked against its intended contract.

questions.prompt: What is a good verification step after practicing “Utility Types: Function and Constructor Types”?
